stories.title: It's Week 10 and everything remains up for grabs in college football
stories.summary: There were plenty of top-ranked matchups in Week 10, but the results didn't solidify anything.

stories.title: CFP top 12 projection: Who's still standing after massive Week 10?
stories.summary: We assess how the selection committee could stack the top teams in the country after Week 10.

stories.title: Freeman, Notre Dame state CFP case, 'leave no doubt' in win over Miami
stories.summary: Fueled by a loss to Miami last season and a No. 11 ranking in the first College Football Playoff rankings release this season, Notre Dame authored a 31-24 victory over the No. 1 Hurricanes on Saturday night in South Bend, Indiana, the Irish's eighth win.

stories.title: Cristobal 'beyond upset' over refs denying Canes tying TD in loss to Irish
stories.summary: Miami coach Mario Cristobal ripped officials over a call that denied Miami a game-tying score late in Saturday night's 31-24 loss to Notre Dame.

stories.title: Georgia flips script on QB Chambliss, dominates Ole Miss in statement win
stories.summary: No. 2 Georgia finally contained Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss, holding him without a passing touchdown en route to a 42-7 blowout win over the No. 10 Rebels on Saturday.
